title: BA3/11/2014 of J.p.joshi Vs State Of Uttarakhand

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Original Jurisdiction
Dated: Nainital: the 1st day of July, 2014
III Bail Application No. 11 of 2014
Order on the Bail Application:
CRIMINAL SIDE
J.P. Joshi ...... Applicant
Versus
State of Uttarakhand ...... Opposite Party
Mr. L.K. Tiwari, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. Masroor Ahmad Khan, Dy. Advocate General with Ms. Mamta
Joshi, Brief Holder for the respondent State.
U.C. Dhyani, J. (Oral)
 The first bail application of the applicant was
dismissed by this Court, vide order dated 24.02.2014. The
second bail application also met the same fate on
07.04.2014.
 This Court need not repeat the grounds on the
basis of which the earlier two bail applications were
dismissed. The reasons thus assigned while disposing of
the first and second bail applications of the applicant are
made part of this order.
 Since no new ground is made out, therefore, it is
not possible to enlarge the accused-applicant on bail. The
third bail application of the applicant is also dismissed.
 Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that
the applicant is suffering from hypertension, diabetes,
spinal complaints and is also having complaint of chronic
low backache with recurrent pain and numbness over right

2
lower limb as was diagnosed by Sr. Medical Officer of
District Jail, Dehradun.
 It is accordingly provided that the applicant-patient be admitted in Doon Hospital in police custody for
treatment for a period of one week, whereafter, the Chief
Medical Officer, Dehradun shall submit a report as to
whether the patient is further required to remain in Doon
Hospital for treatment or not?
 Such report must be filed through the Government
Advocate to this Court after a week.
[
 ( U.C. Dhyani, J. )
